source_row.stem: A nurse educates a community group about mental health parity, referring to laws requiring:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Excluding mental health conditions from coverage for the most part, rather than requiring comparable coverage","B":"Insurance coverage for mental health and substance use conditions to be comparable to coverage for physical health conditions","C":"Requiring coverage mainly for the most severe mental health conditions, rather than comparable coverage overall","D":"Describing a concept generally considered to carry no defined legal basis or enforceable requirement"}}
source_row.rationale: Mental health parity laws generally require insurance coverage for mental health and substance use disorder treatment to be comparable to coverage provided for physical health conditions, reducing historical disparities in access.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Mental Health Parity Laws
